title: AI Wearable That Reads Your Mind
full_monologue: **The AI wearable that reads your mind is here.** Imagine a device that translates your thoughts into action—no typing, no speaking. This tech uses advanced neural sensors to interpret brainwaves in real time. It’s not science fiction anymore. Think about controlling your smart home, composing music, or even communicating with others just by thinking. The future of human-computer interaction is here, and it’s more intuitive than ever. What would you do with a device that reads your mind? Let me know in the comments.
